agents.name: Valuation
agents.role: P/E, P/B, dividend yield, EPS, ROE and percentiles for 24 Nifty indices; India Co. EPS by CY/FY with the 2021 consolidation splice.

agents.name: Flows
agents.role: FPI net equity and total flows by month in USD and INR; 3/12/24-month rolling sums with z-scores and percentiles.

agents.name: External & Rupee
sources: FRED (BIS REER/NEER, USD/INR, OECD India 10Y, US CPI, TIPS)
agents.role: USD/INR, BIS REER/NEER for India and EM peers, India–US 10Y spread, real rates, inflation differential, EM FX volatility.

agents.name: Netra Scout
agents.schedule: 5th–9th of each month, 11:47 IST, until the new edition is found
agents.task_default: Checking dspim.com for a new Netra
agents.role: Finds each new DSP Netra, files it in the year folder on your PC, extracts every number, updates 'Used in Netra' and latest readings, and proposes new metrics.

agents.name: Supervisor (Duty Analyst)
sources: status/ in this repo, GitHub Actions logs
agents.role: Reads every agent's status, investigates failures and stale data, fixes worker code when a source changes, cross-checks key numbers against the latest Netra, and writes a daily note.

agents.name: Ownership & Supply
sources: NSE shareholding patterns, bulk/block deals, SAST/PIT disclosures
agents.role: Promoter/FPI/DII/retail ownership, promoter selling, insider trades, IPO/QIP/OFS supply.

agents.name: India Macro
sources: MOSPI eSankhyiki API, RBI DBIE, GST portal, CGA
agents.role: GDP, CPI, IIP, PMI, GST, core sector, fiscal, capex cycle.

agents.name: Rates & Credit
agents.role: G-sec curve, liquidity, bank credit and deposits, M3, CP/CD rates.

agents.name: Global & US
agents.role: US debt stack, yields, credit spreads, dollar, Fed balance sheet, global/EM equities, AI capex.

agents.name: Commodities
sources: World Bank Pink Sheet, ECB M2, FRED M2, WGC
agents.role: Gold and silver fair value (money-supply model), oil, copper, gold/copper ratio.

agents.name: Market Regime
agents.role: Breadth, size ratios, 200-DMA and negative-streak base rates, VIX, leverage and sentiment.
